describe_character.description: Resolve a natural-language character into the current library.

sketch_scene.description: Arrange an editable scene using installed props.

build_scene.fields: text and/or image (data URL); mode=new|mix|reuse; draw:boolean

refine_scene.description: Fetch the refined result of a build.

build_scene_steps.description: Build a scene in inspectable GLB stages.

design_world.description: Generate a world or validate an edited world against shared rules.

extend_world.description: Generate the next stretch of an existing world.

world_from_scene.description: Expand a scene into an explorable world.

world_from_photo.description: Build a world around a reference image.

auto_world.description: Choose an appropriate world construction method.

review_world.fields: world, image (screenshot data URL); optional before, fix:boolean
review_world.description: Review visible arrangement and optionally correct the design.

cocreate_world.description: Plan additive people, animals and objects; apply to a saved checkpoint separately.

world_event.fields: era, season, time, place, near (list of labels), seen (previous event titles)
world_event.description: Generate an encounter using world context.

learning_question.fields: subject=english|translation|chinese|math|ai|computer (or 英语|英语翻译|语文|数学|AI|计算机), id=learning:x,z, world=64-character lowercase hex world hash, seed=1..999999
learning_question.description: Generate an educational encounter on demand.

write_story.fields: action=outline|cast|segment; outline: text, lines=精简|标准|扩写, language=zh|en (dialogue), scriptLanguage=zh|en (narration); cast/segment: story; segment: start, carried, place, world, note, feedback, owed
write_story.description: Outline, cast or continue a story. Script language and dialogue language are independent.
